## About

I'm a senior at UT Austin studying Art & Entertainment Technology, with a minor in statistics and data science. I work as a product designer and creative technologist in immersive media industry. I like building installations that use light, sound, and space to change how a room feels.

## A few things I'm into

- Immersive and interactive installation art
- Fabrics & 3D Printing
- Vintage films
- Creative coding
